title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature is crucial for handling API requests with JSON or URL-encoded payloads, enabling yantraverse to support a wider range of use cases and improving its overall usability. It will add support for parsing request bodies into JavaScript objects, making it easier to work with API requests. This will enhance the framework's functionality and make it more appealing to developers
acceptance: Request body parsing should work correctly for both JSON and URL-encoded data, and error handling should be implemented for invalid or malformed request bodies
reason: Adding request body parsing will significantly improve yantraverse's ability to handle real-world API scenarios, making it a more competitive and attractive choice for developers building RESTful APIs and other web applications
